correctness.rationale: Represent E by cycle Laplacian L and G=L^+. Real norm duality yields sharp C²=max_{sign s} s^T Gs. Green entries are (N²-1)/(12N)-d(N-d)/(2N). For fixed occupied sign count k, signed quadratic maximization minimizes a strictly concave sum over cyclic gaps; its only minimizing vertices have all but one gap equal 1, i.e. contiguous sign blocks. Summing separations yields k(N-k)[k(N-k)+2]/(3N), maximized at k=floor(N/2) or ceil. The complex spectral gap 4sin²(pi/N) and norm l1<=sqrt N l2 give the complex bound, with first Fourier characters attaining it. Constant-magnitude combinations of plus/minus first modes are excluded unless N=4. New independent exact rational enumeration of 2,040 sign patterns on N=3..10 checked maxima and every maximizer; unrestricted result follows from strict concavity and Fourier spectral argument.

final_claim: For real or complex mean-zero N-cycle vectors (N>=3), E=sum |x_{j+1}-x_j|^2, sharp squared real C is m(N-m)[m(N-m)+2]/(3N), m=floor(N/2); sharp complex C is sqrt(N)/(2sin(pi/N)). Real extremizers are multiples of cycle Green vectors of a contiguous half-cycle sign block; complex ones are first Fourier modes except at N=4 with x=(a,b,-a,-b), |a|=|b|. Real C < complex C except N=4; limit ratio pi/(2sqrt(3)).
